query_snapshot: For hydrogen peroxide solution from 30 to 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- The archived NIOSH table entry for hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) recommends preventing skin contact. [niosh-cpc-az.html, chunk 2323dcf8]
- For hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) the NIOSH archived table lists the 8-hour barrier group as: Butyl; Natural; Nitrile; PE; Viton; CPF3; Responder; Tychem. [niosh-cpc-az.html, chunk 2323dcf8]
- For hydrogen peroxide (solution 30%–70%) the NIOSH archived table lists the 4-hour barrier group as: PVC; PE/EVAL. [niosh-cpc-az.html, chunk 2323dcf8]
